intro: Hi, I'm Mina Kim from Seoul, Korea.
안녕하세요, 저는 한국 서울에서 온 김민아입니다.
I'm a university student majoring in business.
I've been learning English for three years.
In my free time, I like cooking and taking photos.
시간이 날 때는 요리와 사진 찍기를 좋아합니다.
I'm a big fan of British dramas.
My English isn't perfect yet, but I'm working on it.
제 영어는 아직 완벽하지 않지만 노력하고 있습니다.
I'd love to make friends from all over the world.
전 세계 사람들과 친구가 되고 싶습니다.
interview: Thank you for having me today.
Could you tell us a little about yourself?
Why do you want to work for our company?
I admire how your products make people's lives easier.
귀사의 제품이 사람들의 삶을 편하게 해 주는 점을 높이 평가합니다.
My greatest strength is that I never give up.
제 가장 큰 장점은 절대 포기하지 않는다는 것입니다.
One of my weaknesses is that I can be too detail-oriented.
제 약점 중 하나는 세세한 부분에 너무 신경 쓴다는 점입니다.
I once led a team project that finished ahead of schedule.
예정보다 일찍 끝낸 팀 프로젝트를 이끈 적이 있습니다.
Do you have any questions for us?
resume: Dedicated marketing graduate with strong communication skills.
뛰어난 소통 능력을 갖춘 성실한 마케팅 전공 졸업생.
Completed a six-month internship at a global trading company.
Increased social media engagement by thirty percent.
Fluent in Korean and English, with basic Japanese.
한국어와 영어에 능통하고 일본어는 기초 수준입니다.
I am writing to apply for the position of sales assistant.
영업 보조 직무에 지원하고자 글을 드립니다.
I believe my experience makes me a strong fit for this role.
제 경험이 이 직무에 잘 맞는다고 생각합니다.
Thank you for considering my application.
I look forward to hearing from you.
email: I hope this email finds you well.
Thank you for meeting with us last week.
I have attached the documents you requested.
Please let me know if you have any questions.
Could we schedule a call for next Tuesday?
다음 주 화요일로 통화 일정을 잡을 수 있을까요?
I look forward to your reply.
letter: It's getting really cold here in Seoul.
Thank you so much for the lovely birthday gift.
I use it every single day.
I'm planning to visit London next spring.
I can't wait to see you again.
phone: Hello, may I speak to David, please?
This is Mina calling from Seoul Trading.
I'm sorry, he's not available right now.
Would you like to leave a message?
Could you ask him to call me back?
저에게 다시 전화해 달라고 전해 주시겠어요?
request: Excuse me, do you have a minute?
Could you do me a favor?
Would you mind checking this document?
이 서류를 확인해 주실 수 있을까요?

travel: I'd like to check in, please.
I have a reservation under the name Kim.
Could you keep my luggage for a few hours?
몇 시간 동안 짐을 맡아 주실 수 있나요?
How do I get to the nearest subway station?
Can you recommend a good place to eat around here?
이 근처에 괜찮은 식당을 추천해 주실 수 있나요?
Could you take a picture of us?
저희 사진 좀 찍어 주실 수 있나요?
I had a wonderful time here.
